[EN] When they excavated this place, the gulas used slaves—of course!—that they magically animated. There's so much anguish here that the spirits of the slaves cannot return to the Dream—they're trapped here.

Kill the {@LinkCreature:8#4021#reanimated popori} and bring me their pickaxes. I might be able to do something for them.
[ES] Cuando excavaron este lugar, los gulas usaron esclavos —¡por supuesto!— a los que animaron mágicamente. Hay tanta angustia aquí que los espíritus de los esclavos no pueden regresar al Dream; están atrapados aquí.

Mata a los {@LinkCreature:8#4021#reanimated popori} y tráeme sus picos. Tal vez pueda hacer algo por ellos.

[EN] I only hope those poor spirits can return to the Dream now.
[ES] Solo espero que esos pobres espíritus puedan regresar al Dream ahora.

[EN] If you were reanimated as a horrid slave, I'd destroy you. You'd want me to!
[ES] Si te reanimaran como a un esclavo horrible, te destruiría. ¡Querrías que lo hiciera!
